# BB Enterprise Global

> High-trust B2B sourcing and export environment. Premium Global Trade Sourcing Hub.

This site is a B2B platform connecting global buyers with verified export and import products.

## Sections

- [Home](https://www.bbenterpriseglobal.com/) - Main landing page with featured categories and products
- [Collections](https://www.bbenterpriseglobal.com/#collections) - Product categories
- [Products](https://www.bbenterpriseglobal.com/#import-export-products) - All active import and export items

## Notes

- This is a Next.js App Router application.
- All product and category data is dynamically generated.
